name: Fight through the pain (Elan)
body:
–

Benefit: You can tap into the psionic energy that permeates your body to keep going despite certain injuries. You gain a +2 bonus to Autohypnosis checks in order to resist caltrop wounds, stabilize yourself, or resist the secondary effect of poisons.

Special: Only Elans may take this racial trait.
